## Overview `/v1/messages` merges inline system messages into the leading system prompt for every renderer without a jinja template, so Claude Code's per-turn reminders invalidate the prefix cache on DeepSeek V4.1, Kimi K3 and Inkling. Probe the renderer instead of assuming. Fixes #60537. Overlaps #58772 (draft, superset: same probe plus a fold mode), #56520 and #60555 (per-tokenizer flags). This is the probe on its own as a small fix that can land first; I'm coordinating with @bbrowning on #58772. ## Claims - Non-jinja renderers keep inline system messages in place only when the renderer emits them as distinct system turns in order and a trailing one is still followed by the generation prompt; anything else merges as before. - DeepSeek V4.1, Kimi K3, Inkling: now kept in place. DeepSeek V4 (appends system text to the user turn, #46710), V3.2 (trailing system lands after the generation prompt, #53737), Mistral (moves it into the user turn): still merged. - No per-tokenizer registration. HF/jinja path unchanged. ## Validation E2E: Claude Code-style tool loop (system reminder after each tool result) via `/v1/messages`, Inkling with dummy weights (2 layers, H100). `cache_read_input_tokens` per turn: | turn | prompt | main | this PR | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 1716 | 0 | 672 | | 2 | 2756 | 640 | 1696 | | 3 | 3796 | 640 | 2752 | | 4 | 4836 | 672 | 3776 | Main logs the "merged into the leading system prompt" warning at startup; this PR doesn't. A dummy 2-layer DeepSeek V4.1 didn't report prefix hits on either side (cross-layer KV sharing breaks under the layer override), so V4.1 is covered at the render level: each turn's prompt tokens are an exact extension of the previous turn's (371/371 ... 663/663 tokens reused). New test fails on main, passes here: ``` pytest tests/entrypoints/anthropic/test_anthropic_messages_conversion.py -k test_probes_non_jinja_renderer main: FAILED [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-False] - assert True is False here: 3 passed ``` Probe result through real renderers (`renderer_from_config`): V4-Flash merge, V4.1-Flash keep, V3.2-Exp merge, Kimi-K3 keep, Inkling keep, Pixtral (mistral) merge. `tests/entrypoints/anthropic/`: 125 + 7 passed. pre-commit clean. No model evals: prompt text for DeepSeek V4.1, Kimi K3 and Inkling changes (reminders render as system turns where the client sent them instead of in the leading system prompt). ## Details `_should_merge_inline_system` previously only probed jinja templates; non-HF renderers had no template to probe and always merged. The probe renders `[sys, user, sys, user]`, the same with the inline system as user, and `[sys, user, sys]` through `renderer.render_messages`, once at startup. "Didn't raise" is not enough: V4 and V3.2 render without error but misplace the text. ---

nodes.body:
This looks like a reasonable win for the models that don't typically use chat templates. But, some of the models (like Cohere) can be run with a custom template. If we want this to work and not break that type of usage, we'd need to build the ChatParams more like something like the OnlineRenderer does to include the chat template and kwargs: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/ab0e5ef7954190de2a74a6715d1382b08f5accc4/vllm/renderers/online_renderer.py#L214-L218

Otherwise I checked that DeepSeek v4.1, Kimi K3, Inkling, and Cohere all choose to keep inline system with this and render correctly (with the caveat about only correct when using no custom chat template with Cohere). And I checked that DeepSeek v4, DeepSeek v3.2, and Mistral models merge the inline system messages vs keep it separate.

One other small nit, that may or may not be worth fixing, is some models like DeepSeek v4.1 will attach tools to the first system, wherever that is. For typical usage with a harness like Claude Code that's not a problem as there is always an initial system message. But if someone is using their own client with tools but no custom system message, this could potentially end up with the tools attaching to a later mid conversation system message. That seems rare to me in practice, and something we could deal with later if it comes up in real usage.

@bbrowning thanks, good catch. Fixed in 94d9172c4e: the non-jinja probe now builds `ChatParams` from the server's `--chat-template`, content format and default kwargs, like `OnlineRenderer.warmup`.

E2E with Cohere (`trl-internal-testing/tiny-Cohere2ForCausalLM`, `--tokenizer-mode cohere`, dummy weights) and a custom system-first template:

<details><summary>template + request</summary>

```jinja
{%- for message in messages %}
{%- if message.role == 'SYSTEM' and not loop.first %}{{ raise_exception('System message must be at the beginning.') }}{% endif %}
<|START_OF_TURN_TOKEN|>{% if message.role == 'SYSTEM' %}<|SYSTEM_TOKEN|>{% elif message.role == 'USER' %}<|USER_TOKEN|>{% else %}<|CHATBOT_TOKEN|>{% endif %}{% for c in message.content %}{{ c.text }}{% endfor %}<|END_OF_TURN_TOKEN|>
{%- endfor %}
{%- if add_generation_prompt %}<|START_OF_TURN_TOKEN|><|CHATBOT_TOKEN|>{% endif %}
```

```bash
vllm serve trl-internal-testing/tiny-Cohere2ForCausalLM --tokenizer-mode cohere \
  --chat-template system_first.jinja --load-format dummy \
  --hf-overrides '{"hidden_size": 512, "num_attention_heads": 4, "num_key_value_heads": 4, "head_dim": 128, "intermediate_size": 1024}'

curl localhost:8000/v1/messages -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{
  "model": "trl-internal-testing/tiny-Cohere2ForCausalLM", "max_tokens": 8,
  "system": "You are a coding agent.",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "List the files."},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "Running ls."},
    {"role": "system", "content": "<system-reminder>Todo list is empty.</system-reminder>"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Continue."}]}'
```
</details>

| | startup | `/v1/messages` |
|---|---|---|
| before (939ddd7) | no warning, keeps inline system | `400 Render error: ... raise_exception ...` |
| after (94d9172) | "merged into the leading system prompt" warning | 200 |
| after, no `--chat-template` | no warning, keeps inline system | 200 |

Agreed on tools attaching to a later system message; leaving that for a follow-up if it shows up in practice.

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #98349](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/98349) for commit `e7f936f488ea`.

ℹ️ This PR is 75 commits behind upstream `main`. Merged upstream `main` into this branch as `e7f936f488ea` before starting CI. Pull the branch before pushing more changes.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
Thanks for working on this. I tested it locally and the V4.1 fix works. I haven't run a live server.

This branch no longer reads `--chat-template`, but the [warning](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/939ddd7908f02e1fd8e0a4735f14924b994dd919/vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/serving.py#L303) still tells users to pass one. With a template that accepts inline system messages, V4 and V3.2 kept them on main; with this PR they merge and log the same warning. I agree with dropping that override, so could the warning leave out the `--chat-template` hint for non-jinja renderers?

         )

+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        ("model", "expected"),
+        [
+            # Renders inline system messages as system turns; merging them
+            # would break prefix caching for Claude Code's per-turn reminders.
+            ("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", False),
+            # Appends inline system text to the preceding user turn (#46710).
+            ("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash", True),
+            # Puts a trailing system message after the generation prompt.
+            ("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp", True),
+        ],
+    )
+    def test_probes_non_jinja_renderer(self, model, expected):
+        """Encoder-based renderers are probed by rendering, not registered."""
+        from vllm.config import ModelConfig, VllmConfig
+        from vllm.renderers import renderer_from_config
+        from vllm.renderers.online_renderer import OnlineRenderer
+
+        model_config = ModelConfig(model=model)
+        online_renderer = OnlineRenderer(
+            model_config=model_config,
+            renderer=renderer_from_config(VllmConfig(model_config=model_config)),
+            request_logger=None,
+            chat_template=None,
+            chat_template_content_format="auto",
+        )
+        assert (
+            AnthropicServingMessages._should_merge_inline_system(online_renderer)
+            is expected
+        )
+
+    def test_non_jinja_probe_uses_server_chat_template(self):
+        """Renderers that honor --chat-template (e.g. Cohere) probe with it."""
+        renderer = MagicMock()
+        renderer.render_messages.side_effect = ValueError
+        online_renderer = SimpleNamespace(
+            renderer=renderer,
+            chat_template="custom",
+            chat_template_content_format="string",
+            default_chat_template_kwargs={"thinking": False},
+        )
+        AnthropicServingMessages._should_merge_inline_system(online_renderer)
+        params = renderer.render_messages.call_args.args[1]
+        assert params.chat_template == "custom"
+        assert params.chat_template_content_format == "string"
+        assert params.chat_template_kwargs == {
+            "thinking": False,
+            "add_generation_prompt": True,
+        }
+
+    def test_non_jinja_merge_warning_omits_chat_template_hint(self, monkeypatch):
+        """--chat-template may not apply to non-jinja renderers (e.g. V4)."""
+        import vllm.entrypoints.anthropic.serving as serving_mod
+
+        mock_logger = MagicMock()
+        monkeypatch.setattr(serving_mod, "logger", mock_logger)
+        renderer = MagicMock()
+        renderer.render_messages.side_effect = ValueError
+        online_renderer = SimpleNamespace(
+            renderer=renderer,
+            chat_template=None,
+            chat_template_content_format="auto",
+            default_chat_template_kwargs={},
+        )
+        assert AnthropicServingMessages._should_merge_inline_system(online_renderer)
+        assert "--chat-template" not in mock_logger.warning_once.call_args.args[0]
+

@@ -329,6 +340,55 @@ def _detect_merge_inline_system(chat_template: str | None) -> bool:
             # undefined variables) must not abort server startup.
             return True
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _renderer_keeps_inline_system(online_renderer: OnlineRenderer) -> bool:
+        """Probe a non-jinja renderer (e.g. DeepSeek V4.1's encoder).
+
+        Inline system messages must render in order as distinct system turns,
+        and a trailing one must still be followed by the generation prompt.
+        DeepSeek V4 appends their text to the user turn, V3.2 puts it after the
+        generation prompt, and Mistral moves it into the last user turn.
+        """
+        markers = ("SYSA", "USRA", "SYSB", "USRB")
+        messages: list[Any] = [
+            {"role": role, "content": marker}
+            for role, marker in zip(("system", "user") * 2, markers)
+        ]
+        renderer = online_renderer.renderer
+        params = ChatParams(
+            chat_template=online_renderer.chat_template,
+            chat_template_content_format=online_renderer.chat_template_content_format,
+            chat_template_kwargs={"add_generation_prompt": True},
+        ).with_defaults(online_renderer.default_chat_template_kwargs)
+
+        def render(msgs: list[Any]) -> str:
+            _, prompt = renderer.render_messages(msgs, params)
+            text, token_ids, _ = extract_prompt_components(
+                renderer.model_config, parse_dec_only_prompt(prompt)
+            )
+            if text is None:
+                text = renderer.get_tokenizer().decode(token_ids or [])
+            return text
+
+        def separator(text: str) -> str:
+            return text[text.find(markers[1]) + len(markers[1]) : text.find(markers[2])]
+
+        try:
+            full = render(messages)
+            trailing = render(messages[:3])
+            as_user = render([*messages[:2], {**messages[2], "role": "user"}])
+        except Exception:
+            logger.debug("Inline system probe failed", exc_info=True)
+            return False
+        positions = [full.find(marker) for marker in markers]
+        if -1 in positions or positions != sorted(positions):
+            return False
+        system_separator = separator(full)
+        if not system_separator.strip() or system_separator == separator(as_user):
+            return False
+        generation_prompt = full[positions[-1] + len(markers[-1]) :]
+        return trailing.endswith(markers[2] + generation_prompt)
+
